subject: Request to keep pilot active while invoice under audit
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Pruitt <jordan.pruitt@medivue.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to keep pilot active while invoice under audit

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the update on your AP audit. I understand procurement needs to hold the invoice until their review completes; that’s totally fair. We want to avoid your engineering team losing momentum on the Redwood integration while that’s happening.

Would Medivue be open to a short, non-billable buffer so your team can keep running the pilot for another 7 days while procurement finishes the audit? We can provision a conditional credit (no charge unless PO clears) and limit it to the current pilot scope (same models and usage caps). If procurement needs formal wording, I’ve attached a one-page temporary credit agreement and a one-week usage summary from the pilot so far.

If that works, I’ll loop in Marissa for final sign-off and Priyom can confirm the exact token/seat caps. Quick decision here will prevent the proof-of-concept losing momentum.

Thanks —

—David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attach: proposed-temporary-credit-agreement.pdf (attachment stub); pilot-usage-summary.csv (attachment stub)

From: Jordan Pruitt <jordan.pruitt@medivue.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request to keep pilot active while invoice under audit

David —

Appreciate the offer. Procurement put the invoice on hold because they found a vendor tax form discrepancy and are doing a quick audit. They estimate 5–10 business days to clear. Our engineers are in the middle of a run that would be costly to restart (retraining pipelines + baseline checks).

Two clarifying Qs: 1) Will the temporary credit preserve current API keys/limits so we don’t need a re-onboarding? 2) What firm limits will you set (model concurrency, tokens per day)?

Also copying our procurement alias for visibility — they’ll need the temporary-credit wording to match our vendor controls.

Regards,
Jordan
Principal Product Manager, Medivue
Procurement cc'd: procurement@medivue.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Pruitt <jordan.pruitt@medivue.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to keep pilot active while invoice under audit

Jordan —

Thanks for the details and for looping procurement in. Quick answers:
- We will preserve your existing API keys and the project configuration — no re-onboarding required.
- Proposed limits for the 7-day buffer: 25k tokens/day, max 4 concurrent inference sessions, same model variants currently in use. If you expect any spike above that, let us know and we can discuss a targeted burst allowance.

Priyom — I’m authorizing the temporary credit for Medivue under the DEAL-4921-MEDV pilot: 7 calendar days, the caps above. Can you confirm you can enforce the caps and attach the final two-line agreement suitable for procurement?

Jordan — once Priyom drops the final file I recommend procurement signs the one-page agreement and we’ll flip the buffer on same-day.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Pruitt <jordan.pruitt@medivue.com>, procurement@medivue.com
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to keep pilot active while invoice under audit

Hi Jordan / Medivue procurement team —

Attached is a short confirmation statement you can sign. Highlights: 7-day complimentary buffer tied to DEAL-4921-MEDV, preserves current API keys and project configuration, caps at 25,000 tokens/day and 4 concurrent sessions, no data retention change. This is a temporary, non-billable accommodation and will expire automatically at the end of the 7th day.

Attach: proposed-temporary-credit-agreement.pdf (attachment stub)

If you’re OK, please reply-all with a signed acknowledgment (a single line with name, title, and date is fine) and we’ll enable the buffer immediately.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
